## Outcome

Describe the observable behavior or invariant changed.

## Scope

- [ ] The diff is limited to the stated outcome.
- [ ] Generated files were updated through their source of truth.
- [ ] User data, storage, migration, and rollback implications were considered.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Include negative-path evidence for security,
data integrity, migration, release, or deletion changes.

## Release and operations

- [ ] Documentation or runbooks are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] No secrets, temporary diagnostics, or unintended artifacts remain.
- [ ] Release provenance/SBOM or native packaging implications were evaluated.
